The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e2b9ba2768918dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 77. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let (Ω, g, K) satisfy the regularity, completeness, one-end, dominant energy, weighted integrability, and future boundary hypotheses of the initial-data class, with g − b ∈ C2,α τdata , K ∈ C1,α τdata , 3 2 < τdata < 3. Suppose the four metric fluxes in the designated chart are finite. There is no causal or sign assumption on their vector in this theorem. Then p0(g) ≥ s Amin(S; g) 16π  1 + Amin(S; g) 4π  . (7.1) The tensor K may have arbitrary trace, and the boundary may have arbitrarily many components.
